instrumentationScope: Read-only scroll-phase diagnostics add passive DOM listeners, bounded native touch/delegate capture, geometry and existing before/after snapshots. This passive layer adds no evaluations or changes to polling, timeouts, assertions or typing. Native injection uses the separately declared fixed UiAutomation protocol; controller startup and event timing remain recorded. First four busy samples are unchanged; APZ touch dispatch, scroll-phase scheduling and frame timing may be affected by the added work and passive touch listeners.
